objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled information object that contains policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions or other regulated content subject to approval and distribution workflows.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document identifier composed of abbreviation, consecutive number, and title

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state in the document lifecycle such as editing, released, or archived

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date when the document becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when document validity expires

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Primary person responsible for creating and signing the document

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons with change rights on the document

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person responsible for checking technical and formal aspects

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person responsible for approving and releasing document to readers

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person responsible for translating document content to other languages

attributes.name: reader_group
attributes.description: User group with read-only access to the document

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The textual or formatted information contained in the document

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Predefined structure used to create the document

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Systems or applications referenced in the document

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity for the document

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period document is retained after invalidation

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Duration before document requires validity check

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the main document, subject to the same approval workflow and triggering new versions of the main document.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state in the document lifecycle

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date when attachment becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when attachment validity expires

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The file or information contained in the attachment

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Uncontrolled document attachment not subject to release cycle of main document, can be deleted directly and does not create new document versions.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the additional information

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The file or information contained in the additional information

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating if the additional information is published

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Suggestion for amending a document without affecting content or version history until implementation is scheduled.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the change proposal

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the proposal such as created or completed

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person who created the change proposal

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Details of the proposed change

attributes.name: implementation_status
attributes.description: Whether the proposal is planned for implementation

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Workflow request created when document approaches validity expiration to determine if document should be extended, revised, or invalidated.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the validity extension request

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Reference to the document being checked

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the validity extension process

attributes.name: days_before_expiration
attributes.description: Number of days before validity expires that request is created

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity, also referred to as AKS.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the override request

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Reference to the document to be invalidated

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the override process

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Person who created the override request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the reactivation request

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Reference to the document to be reactivated

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the reactivation process

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Person who created the reactivation request

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Configuration of user groups or persons to receive document notifications and access rights upon release.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the distribution list

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution such as by email or for acknowledgement

attributes.name: user_groups
attributes.description: Groups assigned to receive distribution

attributes.name: persons
attributes.description: Individual persons assigned to receive distribution

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person with roles and permissions in the system.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the user

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: Group membership that determines access and permissions

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users with common roles and permissions such as readers or authors.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the user group

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Common role assigned to group members

attributes.name: members
attributes.description: Users belonging to the group

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: Process for managing approval and release of documents through defined steps.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the workflow

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of workflow such as release, validity extension, override, or reactivation

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the workflow

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Current step in the workflow process

attributes.name: participants
attributes.description: Users assigned to complete workflow steps

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature applied by workflow participants documenting approval.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the signature

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who applied the signature

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when signature was applied

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: Step in the workflow where signature was applied

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by a user that they have received and reviewed a document.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the acknowledgement

attributes.name: user
attributes.description: Person who provided acknowledgement

attributes.name: document_version
attributes.description: Version of document being acknowledged

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when acknowledgement was provided

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the acknowledgement such as confirmed or pending

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document in a different language requiring separate approval.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the language version

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language code or name of the translation

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the language version such as released

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person who translated the document

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person who reviewed the translation

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person who released the translation

objs.name: client
objs.description: Instance in a multi-client system with its own document visibility scope.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the client

attributes.name: documents
attributes.description: Documents visible in this client

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new document object in the system with selection of document type and template

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Editing of document content through implemented editing client and Office components

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintenance of standardized and customer-specific metadata and attributes for a document

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of document from source format to PDF for web display

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Addition of controlled document attachment to a document

evts.name: delete_attachment
evts.description: Removal of attachment from document

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking attachment for archiving and archiving after release of next document version

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Addition of uncontrolled document attachment to a document

evts.name: publish_additional_information
evts.description: Making additional information visible through published flag

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Direct removal of additional information from document

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of suggested amendment to document without affecting content or version history

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Marking change proposal for implementation

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Documentation of editing and completion of change proposal

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature by workflow participant documenting approval at workflow step

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Automatic publication and distribution of document to addressed readers

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-triggered workflow request when document approaches validity expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declaration of extended validity for document with updated valid until date

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Request to invalidate and archive document that has no additional validity

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Declaration of invalid status and archiving of document with revocation of authorizations

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Request to re-validate previously invalidated and archived document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirmation of reactivation creating new version with retained metadata and properties

evts.name: create_language_version
evts.description: Creation of translated version of released document

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Automatic email notification to assigned user groups and persons upon document release

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic workflow-supported request for acknowledgement sent to assigned recipients

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by recipient of document receipt and review

evts.name: assign_to_client
evts.description: Configuration of client visibility for document

o2o.description: A document can have multiple attachments
A document can have multiple additional information
Change proposals belong to and are displayed in a document
Language versions are translated versions of a released document
Documents can reference other documents through references attribute
Validity extension request is linked to the document being checked
Override request references the document to be invalidated
Reactivation request references the document to be reactivated
Distribution list assigns user groups to receive notifications
Distribution list can directly assign individual persons
Distribution lists are maintained for each document
Documents have visibility scope in clients

o2e.description: Document is created in the system
Document properties and metadata are maintained
Document is converted to PDF format
Additional information is added to document
Change proposal is created for document
Change proposal is scheduled for implementation
Signature is applied by workflow participant
Document is assigned to client visibility
